name: cloudideaas-vscode-debugger
description: A minimal debugger/web server that works on F5, no more ice age style console.log debugging or relying on browser dev tools. Works by convention over configuration

scripts.vsce:publish: npm run vsce:verify && npm run vsce:publish:raw
scripts.release:prepare: npm run publish:adapter && npm run bundle && npm run vsce:list
scripts.release:prepare:skip-adapter: npm run bundle && npm run vsce:list
scripts.release:patch: bumpp patch --yes --no-commit --no-tag --no-push && npm run release:prepare && npm run vsce:package && npm run vsce:verify
scripts.release:minor: bumpp minor --yes --no-commit --no-tag --no-push && npm run release:prepare && npm run vsce:package && npm run vsce:verify
scripts.release:major: bumpp major --yes --no-commit --no-tag --no-push && npm run release:prepare && npm run vsce:package && npm run vsce:verify
scripts.release:patch:skip-adapter: bumpp patch --yes --no-commit --no-tag --no-push && npm run release:prepare:skip-adapter && npm run vsce:package && npm run vsce:verify
scripts.release:minor:skip-adapter: bumpp minor --yes --no-commit --no-tag --no-push && npm run release:prepare:skip-adapter && npm run vsce:package && npm run vsce:verify
scripts.release:major:skip-adapter: bumpp major --yes --no-commit --no-tag --no-push && npm run release:prepare:skip-adapter && npm run vsce:package && npm run vsce:verify
scripts.publish:patch: npm run release:patch && npm run vsce:publish
scripts.publish:minor: npm run release:minor && npm run vsce:publish
scripts.publish:major: npm run release:major && npm run vsce:publish
scripts.publish:patch:skip-adapter: npm run release:patch:skip-adapter && npm run vsce:publish
scripts.publish:minor:skip-adapter: npm run release:minor:skip-adapter && npm run vsce:publish
scripts.publish:major:skip-adapter: npm run release:major:skip-adapter && npm run vsce:publish
